title: Grilled Pineapple Skewers
description: A simple and sweet vegan dessert, perfect for warm weather. This recipe showcases the natural sweetness of pineapple, paired with a hint of yeasty flavor.

ingredients.name: Australian bush tomatoes
ingredients.notes: such as bush cherry or quandong

instructions: 2. Thread pineapple, bush tomatoes, and thyme onto skewers.
3. Brush the skewers with a little water.
4. Sprinkle crumbled stale bread over the skewers.
5. Grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the pineapple is caramelized and the bread is toasted.
6. Serve warm, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
